As 'prajāpati-pati', the name symbolizes the divine presence and protection that one can seek in their daily life. Furthermore, it serves as a reminder of the importance of spiritual figures in the Hindu tradition and the role they play in guiding individuals on their spiritual path. This name fosters a deep sense of reverence towards the divine and can instill feelings of humility, awe, and gratitude.
